issues.on_page: Public Building > Community center > Capital outlay 5,299
issues.issue: The printed function heading is 'Public Building', not Culture and Recreation. The capital outlay rule takes the function only from what is printed, so the label could be 'Capital Outlay: Public Building'. disbursements[6] 'Public Building' 67,769 (p6) is also placed in culture/recreation by inference (community center).

The governmental funds statement (p6) counts this amount in Capital outlay (1,707,040 + 137,910 = 1,844,950), so the detail category differs from the statement line's category capital outlay. Defensible because the row label doesn't say capital outlay.
